title: Cut the skills' cost to near-baseline
description: Round one (v2) showed no outcome advantage over a strong baseline while the skills cost 1.3-2.9x tokens and 2.6-8.5x wall time. Reduce cost without losing the evidence the skills add: sequential stopping when an effect dwarfs the noise, no verifier subagent below R4, a lighter ledger for obvious wins, bolder default posture.

acceptanceCriteria.text: A round-one rerun with several runs per arm shows with-skill token and time cost within 1.5x of baseline
Outcome scores do not drop and process evidence remains reproducible
